page.overview:
Who is Senjuro Rengoku?

Senjuro is a boy with fair skin, bushy black eyebrows, and large, gold eyes that redden near his white pupils, that are slanted inwards and shaped so as to give him a determined yet kind appearance. Senjuro has a similar appearance to his brother, Kyojuro Rengoku, and father, Shinjuro Rengoku, possessing unruly golden hair that flares out around his face, becoming red near the ends above his ears and shoulders, that he wears messily tied back behind his head.

Senjuro wears a plain white yukata and juban with darker umanori-styled hakama pants, secured with a red obi sash. In Kyojuro Rengoku's memory dream in the Mugen Train, he wore a dark haori above his white yukata.

Senjuro is originally seen to be very sad and rattled by his brother's death and his father's verbal abuse, but, after spending some time talking to Tanjiro Kamado, his true personality as a kind, caring individual who can usually see the best in a situation or person shines through. He has hope for his future, and even though he knows that by not becoming a Demon Slayer he has broken his family's ancient tradition, he knows that his older brother, Kyojuro, would forgive him for leaving such a scar on their history.

It's noted that, at some point in his life, Senjuro was to become Kyojuro's successor and so had been training to become a Demon Slayer. However, due to his lack of skill in the field, Senjuro had to give up on that dream and decided to spend his life helping people in other ways.
